dict.string: CORSIA uses this to find your other computers running CORSIA, and to let them connect when you turn that on in Settings.
CORSIA uses the microphone when you talk with your agents, or when you ask an agent to make a call or record a meeting.
CORSIA uses this to hear the other people on a call or in a meeting when you ask an agent to record it.
CORSIA uses this when you ask an agent to work in another app, such as sending a text from Messages.
